description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of sample counts and proportional representation across the ten subtasks that constitute the MMRA benchmark, designed to evaluate multi-granularity and multi-image relational association capabilities in large visual language models. Each slice corresponds to a distinct subtask, labeled with its name, sample count, and percentage of the total benchmark. The largest slice is “ObservationAngle” with 126 samples (12.28%), followed by “SimilarMaterial” with 106 (10.33%), and “SubEvent” with 100 (9.74%). Three subtasks — “SimilarEvent,” “AppearanceSimilarity,” and “Layout” — each contain 90 samples (8.77% each), while “Environment” also has 90 samples (8.77%). “MentalitySimilarity” accounts for 89 samples (8.67%), “RelativePosition” for 81 (7.90%), and the smallest slice, “NearSameEntity,” contains 63 samples (6.34%). The chart uses distinct colors for each category and includes both absolute counts and percentage values within each slice, enabling a clear visual comparison of task distribution across the benchmark.
